defects.title: A requested rxnGeneMat that the model lacks marks the genes of the changed reaction only
defects.note: input skipped; no src caller requests rxnGeneMat for a model without one

defects.title: The help gives true as the default of addRxnGeneMat

notes: Fixed by feature 20261125-161147-blocker-fixes-two (maintainer approval 2026-11-25, decision 3, fixes a-c): nGenes is updated after the new genes are appended, so extendModelFieldsForType extends proteins, geneNames and the other gene fields; with geneNameList and systNameList each gene name of the rule is translated by its own position (a name not in the list is kept) before the look-up in model.genes, so a translated gene already in the model is reused; a requested rxnGeneMat that the model lacks is created as reactions x genes. The quarantine test was replaced by a full test, seen to fail on the old code (proteins not extended) and to pass on the new; 43/43 lines covered. Open (not a defect of the fix): a newly created rxnGeneMat marks only the changed reaction's genes, as before 2017; the help still gives addRxnGeneMat default = true while the code defaults to true only when the model has rxnGeneMat.
